context: Tests whether the agent correctly creates the spec directory structure, spec.md content using the prescribed template, and the _current pointer file when starting a brand-new spec from scratch with Standard depth.

checklist.name: 4-digit zero-padded spec dir
checklist.description: The spec directory is named with a 4-digit zero-padded number prefix, e.g. `specs/0001-notification-center/` or similar (NOT `specs/1-*` or `specs/notification-center/`)

checklist.name: spec.md created
checklist.description: A `spec.md` file exists inside the numbered spec directory

checklist.name: status frontmatter field
checklist.description: spec.md has a YAML frontmatter block containing a `status` field

checklist.name: depth frontmatter field
checklist.description: spec.md has a YAML frontmatter block containing a `depth` field

checklist.name: status set to Draft
checklist.description: The `status` value in spec.md frontmatter is exactly `Draft`

checklist.name: Story section present
checklist.description: spec.md contains a `## Story` section with content in the 'As a ..., I want ..., so that ...' pattern

checklist.name: Requirements section present
checklist.description: spec.md contains a `## Requirements` section with at least one acceptance criterion

checklist.name: Out of Scope section present
checklist.description: spec.md contains an `## Out of Scope` section

checklist.name: _current pointer written
checklist.description: A file `specs/_current` exists and contains the name of the newly created spec directory (e.g. `0001-notification-center`)
